# Recorded attestation chains

Copied unchanged from [android/keyattestation](https://github.com/android/keyattestation) `testdata/`
(Apache-2.0, Copyright Google LLC), on 2026-11-17:

| File | Source | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `sony-xperia10-iii-TEE_EC.pem` | `testdata/sony-xperia10-iii/sdk33/TEE_EC.pem` | TEE, locked, verified boot, RSA root |
| `frankel-TEE_EC_2026.pem` | `testdata/frankel/sdk37/TEE_EC_2026.pem` | TEE, locked, verified boot, 2026 EC root |
| `akita-TEE_EC_NONE.pem` | `testdata/akita/sdk34/TEE_EC_NONE.pem` | TEE, unlocked bootloader |
| `marlin-TEE_EC_NONE.pem` | `testdata/marlin/sdk29/TEE_EC_NONE.pem` | Software keystore |
